note: Three populations on CD3 × CD19. CD19pos: B cells — distinct cluster at the upper-left (CD19+, CD3-). CD3pos: T cells — distinct cluster at the lower-right (CD3+, CD19-). The double-negative center cluster is unassigned. CD3 and CD19 are bimodal — boundaries set at the valley between the positive and negative peaks of each axis.
tips: Lymphocyte lineage split on pre-gated Live singlet lymphocytes. CD19pos: CD19+ CD3-. CD3pos: CD3+ CD19-. CD3- CD19- events (NK cells, residual non-B/T lineages) are not annotated at this step because the remainder is not a defined cell type for this panel's purpose.
